authority: Labor Code art.87; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 (https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf) ch.4 §C and ch.1 §A: hours beyond eight a day at 125% of the hourly rate on an ordinary day, 169% on a rest day or special day, 195% on a special day that is the rest day, 260% on a regular holiday, 338% on a regular holiday that is the rest day, 390% / 507% on a double holiday (`work.days[].overtime_hours`, the approved hours). The daily rate is the monthly basic × 12 ÷ the contract term fact `days_per_year` (Handbook ch.2 §D–E: 365 when rest days, special days and regular holidays are paid; 313 on a six-day week; 261 on a five-day week; 305 / 253 where the special days are unpaid; 313 when unrecorded); the hourly rate is a day ÷ 8. A salary paid on a factor already pays the days that factor counts, so a worked day adds only what the Handbook total exceeds that: regular holidays are inside every factor, special days inside 365/313/261, rest days inside 365 only. Premium, overtime and night pay are owed to every employee except managerial staff, field personnel, workers paid by results and kasambahay (Handbook chs.3–5 §B). A double special (non-working) day (`holiday_kind` DOUBLE_SPECIAL) is paid 150% for its first eight hours, 195% on the rest day; its overtime 195% / 253.5% (DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.1 §A).
